hooks.command: s=${PADDOCK_STATE_DIR:-${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/paddock}; p=$(grep -o '"\(file\|notebook\)_path" *: *"[^"]*"' | head -n 1 | sed 's/^[^:]*: *"//; s/"$//'); case "$p" in ''|*\\*) echo "org: refused: the file tool's path is missing or has a JSON escape (quote, backslash or control character), so the hook cannot check it against the org state folder (Issue #245)" >&2; exit 2 ;; "~/"*) p=$HOME/${p#"~/"} ;; esac; case "$(realpath -m -- "$p")/" in "$(realpath -m -- "$s")"/*) echo "org: refused: the file tools do not write the org state folder $s (Issue #245); use the org commands" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

if [ -n "${PADDOCK_ORG:-}" ]; then bash "$PADDOCK_ORG" --as codex-gate codex_round hook || exit 2; elif grep -qi codex; then echo 'org: refused: PADDOCK_ORG is not set, so a call naming codex cannot be counted' >&2; exit 2; fi
